_approach: The canonical uplifting-trance drop skeleton: a straight 909 four-on-the-floor kick, closed hats on every 16th, an open hat choking the closed hat on every offbeat 8th (the 'off-beat is particularly important in uplifting trance' consensus across production guides), clap/snare on 2 and 4, and a crash marking bar 1. Straight timing throughout — trance's swing convention treats 50% as straight and this style sits at the bottom of the scale. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
